test.create_query: CREATE TABLE limit_by_outer_limit (c1 UUID, c2 String, c3 UUID, c4 DateTime64(6, 'UTC')) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(c4) ORDER BY (c1, c2, c3, c4) SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
